_comment: EEI Imobiliara Investment SRL — Dec 2025 AUDITED reference (year-end convention).
Every value is the Solduri finale (closing balance) from balanta verificare EEI dec 2025.pdf.
This is the convention used by Romanian statutory financial statements, Patria Bank
covenant measurement, and the published v5 annual analysis report.
Convention: amount = closing_dr for debit-natural accounts; closing_cr for credit-natural.
P&L values are YTD movement totals (Sume totale) since P&L accounts close to zero at year-end.
Tolerance for CI: ±1 RON on absolutes, ±0.01 on ratios.
Source-of-truth account amounts (closing balances per Solduri finale columns)
drive every assertion in scripts/validate_eei_canonical.py. Do NOT modify
without re-running the verify_mapping.py reference against the source PDF.

_ebitda_conventions_note: Three EBITDA views, all internally consistent:
ebitda_financial_view (audit firms / IFRS): 722 in revenue, 767 below EBIT → 2,127,403.70
Net profit is the same RON 1,425,245.58 in all three — the differences are presentation only.

operating_view._convention: Romanian SME / CRE default — matches the reference output

must_not._ev_ebitda_primary: EV/EBITDA is NEVER primary for CRE or negative EBITDA
